authentication_boundary: The competition build has no authentication or authorization boundary. The listener is loopback-only (COVENIA_LISTEN_HOST defaults to 127.0.0.1); any local process that can reach the port may call all four endpoints. Do not expose this process beyond the local host.

cors.options_note: CORS preflight is answered by Starlette's CORSMiddleware before routing, so no OPTIONS route exists in the mounted route table; it is framework behaviour for the four POST routes, not a fifth business API.

documentation_routes.statement: The interactive documentation endpoints are disabled by construction (docs_url=redoc_url=openapi_url=None on the application factory), so no fifth business API and no schema UI is served. Setting any of those arguments would re-open them; competition runs keep them closed.

model_provider.blocker_behaviour: An unregistered deployment yields MODEL_UNAVAILABLE (503) from analyze; no synthetic or cached candidate is returned.

runtime_notices: model deployment is not registered; analyze answers MODEL_UNAVAILABLE (missing: model_deployment_id)
extraction cache is disabled; every analyze calls the model provider
verified extractions are process-owned and in memory; after a restart analyze must run again before evaluate
